author: BlueberryHopes
body:
Hey, I'm Christer192 on Minecraft. 

I just recently got banned. Reason: Excessive Infractions. Today 3 July 2015 at 4:48 PM - banned by zacd56
That's right. No false bans. 

I'm afraid if I'm banned forever. It's why I'm making this appeal request. No I haven't waited long to be unbanned, I just got banned. I'm just hoping there's any chance to become unbanned again. I hope you staffs will accept my request to be unbanned again now or later, if not, then it's ok. I'm fine with it. I will just stay unbanned forever then?

I will say sorry for what I've done in the server, like spamming, bad language, rudeness, griefing and more things. I regret it. Not because I want to be back to server, but it's bad. I understand, my punishment is just. It's okay if I can't be unbanned again. I will stop doing these bad things.

What can I do to be unbanned? Let me back if you want, and if I do one more infraction in avicus server, then ban me forever.

- Christer192

title: I want to be unbanned

replies.author: Two_Become_One
replies.body:
Hello Christer192,

Unfortunately I have decided to deny your appeal.

You simply have not learned from the large amount of infractions that has been dealt. This has lead to a Permanent ban. You must face the consequences. 

You can attempt to appeal this ban at a later date.

Regards,
Devil_Fruit, Senior Mod.
